title: arthraxon langsdorffii var. centrasiaticus
intro: Arthraxon langsdorffii var. centrasiaticus, commonly known as Western Sweetgrass, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the grass family (Poaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Western Sweetgrass include its expectorant and antispasmodic effects, which help to relieve congestion and soothe the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of Western Sweetgrass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
